latest_release.name: v2.15.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Decode indexed nested arrays in numeric order by @afurm in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1723
* Make Connection#dup public and rebuild its middleware stack by @JelF in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1718
* Fix FrozenError when a frozen URI is passed as the base URL by @hikmetba-bit in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1717
* [LOW] Bound memory retained by remote header names by @OskarEichler in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1698
* Apply logging filters to exception messages by @OskarEichler in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1702
* Preserve response state while releasing callbacks by @OskarEichler in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1703
* Memoize false option values without recomputing by @OskarEichler in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1706
* Freeze the default allowed status list by @OskarEichler in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1707
* Default Connection#support_parallel? to the connection's adapter by @ybai08 in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1725
* Add integration tests for the Options classes by @iMacTia in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1724
* Ship only the specs external adapters need by @sampokuokkanen in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1726
* Preserve false request bodies for JSON encoding by @OskarEichler in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1691
* Add integration tests for JSON literal request bodies by @iMacTia in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1728
* Keep header index synchronized across Hash mutations by @OskarEichler in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1700
* fix: honor include_request: false in all errors by @yykamei in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1729
* Escape params 2x faster with half the allocations, using CGI.escape by @czj in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1727
* [MEDIUM] Pin actions used for RubyGems publication by @OskarEichler in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1710
* [MEDIUM] Lock the RubyGems release dependency graph by @OskarEichler in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1712

## New Contributors
* @afurm made their first contribution in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1723
* @JelF made their first contribution in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1718
* @hikmetba-bit made their first contribution in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1717
* @ybai08 made their first contribution in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1725
* @sampokuokkanen made their first contribution in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1726
* @czj made their first contribution in https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/pull/1727

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lostisland/faraday/compare/v2.15.0...v2.15.1
